message.content:
The image is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large black serif font. Below the title is the text "50 Tahun!" in a cursive font. Two lines of smaller white text at the top read "MEMBONGKAR AKAR MASALAH SAMPAH / INSENTIF PAJAK MOBIL BUAT SIAPA". The main headline in large, black, bold sans-serif font is "SALING SALIP DEMI VAKSIN".

Centrally, a vertical wooden pole topped with a basket-like woven bamboo structure extends upwards. Next to it, an umbrella handle with a brown curved grip and black canopy fabric points down. Numerous orange-toned hands reach upward from the bottom edge of the frame. Below the letters "M" and "P" of "TEMPO," a small glass vial with a silver cap hangs from a thin vertical wire. 

A block of black text on the left states: "Di tengah program vaksinasi massal Covid-19, tersebar kabar miring soal jatah vaksin yang jatuh pada mereka yang tak berhak. Para pengusaha akan mendatangkan 35 juta vaksin tambahan dari Rusia." Small text at the bottom right includes a date "22-28 FEBRUARI 2021", a price "RP 45.000", a URL, a QR code, and a barcode. A thick red vertical border lines the left side.
